business_scope.primary_industry_name: Compression Molding of Food-Grade Silicone Tactile Sensory Fidgets

meta_jurisdiction_context.sovereign_country_en: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

OECD Multilateral Convention on Mutual Administrative Assistance in Tax Matters (extended by the United Kingdom to Gibraltar)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Proceeds of Crime Act 2015 (Gibraltar); Criminal Justice (Money Laundering) Regulations 2019; Sanctions and Anti-Money Laundering Act 2019; Companies (Beneficial Ownership) Regulations 2018; Limited Partnerships (Beneficial Ownership) Regulations 2021; Limited Partnerships Act 1996; Companies Act 2014

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized copy of the valid passport page of each proposed general partner and each ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the country of residence of the individual; for UK-issued documents, a UK notary public recognised by the Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille by the competent authority in the issuing jurisdiction (e.g., UK FCDO Apostille Unit; for non-Hague jurisdictions, consular legalization at a British embassy or consulate)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified proof of residential address for each ultimate beneficial owner and general partner (utility bill or bank statement issued within the last three months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Local utility provider or a regulated bank in the individual's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization followed by Hague Apostille if the document originates from a Hague Convention state; otherwise consular legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing for any corporate general partner or corporate ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry or similar competent corporate registrar in the corporate entity's jurisdiction of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille by the issuing country's competent authority; if the issuing jurisdiction is not a party to the Hague Convention, full consular legalization through the relevant embassy or consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Signed AML/KYC beneficial ownership declaration (Form UBO-ELP) declaring the ownership chain and total percentage interests
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Proposed general partner of the Exempted Limited Partnership, signed before a notary public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization plus Hague Apostille or consular legalization as applicable to the jurisdiction where the declaration is executed

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-onboarding and pre-incorporation screening against the United Nations Consolidated List, UK OFSI Consolidated List (extended to Gibraltar), Gibraltar Sanctions List, OFAC Specially Designated Nationals List, EU/UK PEP databases and World-Check. Conduct risk-based enhanced due diligence for politically exposed persons, high-risk jurisdictions and complex ownership structures. Maintain all screening records for at least five years and monitor changes in beneficial ownership continuously during the life of the entity.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Gibraltar Companies Registry (Companies House Gibraltar) – E-Services Portal via www.companieshouse.gi
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All statutory filings must be in English and names must be submitted in Latin script. Where a desired brand or corporate name originates in non-Latin script, a certified phonetic transliteration into Latin script must accompany the application. Once registered, the official name used in all Gibraltar records, banking mandates and contracts is the Latin-script name; no local-language version is accepted except as a trading name.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the name application is rejected, a written administrative appeal must be filed within 14 days with the Registrar of Companies, together with a detailed name search report, explanation of the proposed name and any evidence of prior use. The Registrar must issue a decision within 30 days. There is no automatic extension of a reserved name; after the 30-day reservation expires, a fresh application and fee must be submitted. Exhaustion of this administrative appeal is a precondition before any judicial review application may be made to the Supreme Court of Gibraltar.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office arrangement is permissible for administrative purposes provided the Exempted Limited Partnership maintains a physical registered office in Gibraltar at the location of its licensed registered agent. Remote management and mail-forwarding through the registered agent are acceptable for the ELP's internal operations; however, a pure virtual office without a registered physical address in Gibraltar is not sufficient to meet the statutory registered office requirement or to satisfy commercial substance expectations for new European-EMI bank account openings.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low for a low-risk standard manufacturing and novelty fidget toy entity; approximated 5% annual probability of unannounced on-site inspection by the Gibraltar Financial Services Commission or the local police, increasing materially to roughly 30% if AML red flags are raised, sanction matches occur, or a bank-account-opened counterparty refuses to provide substance evidence.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Limited Partnerships Act 2014 (Gibraltar), sections 3, 5, 7, 9, 12 and 22; Income Tax Act 2010, section 10(6) (partnership pass-through); General Partner is a company incorporated under Companies Act 2014 (Gibraltar) where applicable.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Companies Registry, Gibraltar Financial Services Commission (GFSC), Eurotowers, 95 Europort Avenue, Gibraltar
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form LP-ELP – Application for Registration of a Limited Partnership as an Exempted Limited Partnership
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital is required for a Gibraltar Exempted Limited Partnership; no escrow bank account or capital deposit condition is imposed. Capital contributions and funding obligations are contractual and must be specified in the Limited Partnership Agreement.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: (1) that the application for registration of the Exempted Limited Partnership under the Limited Partnerships Act 2014 be approved and the registered agent is instructed to file Form LP-ELP with the GFSC Companies Registry; (2) that the initial partnership interest subscription of each founding Limited Partner, as set out in the Subscription Schedule, is accepted and recorded in the capital accounts; (3) that the registered office be established at the address stated in the application, with the registered agent duly appointed; (4) that the named General Partner and the named Compliance Officers be appointed to hold office until replaced; and (5) that the General Partner be authorised to execute the Limited Partnership Agreement, open bank accounts and obtain the industrial and environmental permits required for manufacturing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GFSC Companies Registry – Name Clearance Desk via e-Registry online portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a proposed Exempted Limited Partnership name through the GFSC online name clearance module. Provide a signed confirmation that the proposed name is not offensive, misleading or identical to an existing Gibraltar entity. No notarization is required at this stage.
required_dossiers: Principal place of business within Gibraltar
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected or queried, file a written clarification explaining the business context or submit an alternative proposed name; resubmission is processed within 3 additional business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of Limited Partnership Agreement
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public and Licensed Registered Agent; final document is later filed with GFSC Companies Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Limited Partnership Agreement containing names, capital contributions, profit-sharing ratios, reserved matters, indemnities, dissolution mechanism and General Partner powers. Execute the agreement by the General Partner and all Limited Partners. For registry purposes, original signatures or electronic signatures with legalization are accepted.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incumbency of the General Partner
Passport or national ID of each partner
Proof of registered office address in Gibraltar
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry determines the agreement is defective or inconsistent with Form LP-ELP, revise the affected clauses, re-execute the document and file a consolidated amendment before resubmission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Registration Application with GFSC Companies Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GFSC Companies Registry – e-Registry online portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit Form LP-ELP together with the executed Limited Partnership Agreement, name clearance certificate, proof of registered office, and due diligence documents for all partners. Pay the statutory filing fee of USD 250 electronically. The application must confirm that the ELP intends to apply for tax-exempt status.
required_dossiers: Due diligence files for General Partner and Limited Partners
Consent of the registered office provider
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried, provide the requested clarification or additional due diligence within 14 calendar days; failure to respond results in automatic suspension which is cured by refiling the corrected form with a fresh affidavit of correction.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Receipt of Certificate of Registration and ELP Tax Exemption Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GFSC Companies Registry and Gibraltar Commissioner of Income Tax
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After approval, the Companies Registry issues the Certificate of Registration of the Exempted Limited Partnership. Within the same week, apply to the Commissioner of Income Tax for the exemption certificate confirming that the ELP is tax transparent and exempt from Gibraltar income tax on non-Gibraltar-source income.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Registration of the ELP
Limited Partnership Agreement with tax allocation clauses
Declaration that no Gibraltar-source income is anticipated
Annual return and taxable status election form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax exemption certificate is not issued within 10 days, submit a written follow-up request to the Commissioner of Income Tax and attach proof of the original application; further delay is addressed by a formal statutory review request.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Registration Governance, Beneficial Ownership Filing and Bank Account Opening
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GFSC AML Unit and Gibraltar commercial banks (optional EMI providers)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the beneficial ownership register with the GFSC AML Unit within the statutory timeline. Submit the Certificate of Registration, ELP tax exemption certificate, due diligence pack and source of funds declaration to a Gibraltar bank or European EMI permitted to onboard the ELP. For low-risk fidget toy manufacturing, the bank will apply standard KYC without enhanced due diligence.
required_dossiers: Passport and proof of address for all beneficial owners
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank queries the application, provide a business plan, product-safety certifications and the ELP tax exemption certificate; if the initial bank is intrusive, approach a second-tier Gibraltar bank or licensed EMI with lower documentary requirements.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Industrial, Environmental and Civil Defence Licensing Applications
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of the Environment, Sustainability and Climate Change; Gibraltar Fire and Rescue Service; Occupational Health and Safety Division
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit an industrial notification and environmental registration for the low-impact compression molding of food-grade silicone fidgets. Apply for the Fire and Safety Certificate covering the production floor and storage areas. Obtain occupational clearance confirming the premises comply with Gibraltar health, safety, noise and structural requirements.
required_dossiers: Building plans and structural load calculations
Food-grade silicone safety data sheet and EN 71 / EU 1935/2004 compliance declarations
Waste disposal contract for silicone scrap
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the environmental or fire licensing officer imposes conditions disproportionate to the operations, submit a revised technical memorandum with an independent consultant's report and apply for an administrative review within 30 days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Environmental Health and Industrial Licensing Division, Department of the Environment, Sustainability and Climate Change, HM Government of Gibraltar
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Small-Scale Manufacturing and Food-Contact Silicone Assembly Permit (light industrial / non-chemical processing)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environmental Impact Assessment Unit, Department of the Environment, Sustainability and Climate Change, HM Government of Gibraltar
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Schedule 2 Mini-Impact Screening / Annual Environmental Registration – Category B. A full EIA report is not required because the process involves compression molding of pre-cured food-grade silicone with annual VOC emissions below 5 tonnes.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater pH must be 6–9 with COD not exceeding 1,000 mg/L before discharge to municipal sewer; silicone flash and scrap must be classified as non-hazardous waste and recycled through a licensed contractor; air extraction must ensure VOC concentration below 50 mg/m³ at boundary; all silicone must meet EU Regulation 1935/2004 and UK equivalent food-contact material requirements, as applicable to export into the United Kingdom and European Union.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate required from the Gibraltar Fire and Rescue Service covering production and storage areas; structural load inspection under BS EN 1991 and BS EN 13814; occupational health clearance from the Health and Safety at Work Authority, including noise monitoring below 85 dB(A) daily, safe raw material storage, and mandatory ventilation to prevent dust accumulation.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: HM Government of Gibraltar - Income Tax Office (Commissioner of Income Tax), 6 Cathedral Square, Gibraltar; online filing portal: Gibraltar Income Tax e-Services (https://www.gibraltar.gov.gi/taxation).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign-owned Exempted Limited Partnerships (ELPs) must (1) register with the Registrar of Companies under the Limited Partnerships Act to obtain the partnership certificate; (2) apply to the Income Tax Office for a partnership tax reference via Form PT1; (3) register with the General Consumption Tax (GCT) Office via Form GCT1 once the GBP 150,000 annual taxable turnover threshold is met or exceeded. Resident partners obtain individual Gibraltar TINs; non-resident partners deriving no Gibraltar-source income are not obliged to hold a Gibraltar TIN.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Partnership transparency is mandatory under the Income Tax Act 2010, and no check-the-box election regime exists. Partners may, however, elect profit-sharing ratios and capital versus revenue allocation in the partnership agreement, elect the territorial source exemption for non-resident partners with respect to foreign-source income, and the ELP may elect GCT group registration with related Gibraltar entities where the common-control conditions are satisfied.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Gibraltar General Consumption Tax (GCT) with Customs and Excise Duties
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: GBP 150,000 per annum of taxable supplies in Gibraltar; importers of taxable goods are registrable irrespective of turnover.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, API stamping, or continuous transaction control (CTC) e-invoicing mandate. Invoices are self-issued and must state the supplier's GCT reference and, for exports, the legend 'Zero Rated - Export'. GCT returns are submitted quarterly via the Income Tax Office e-portal with supporting schedules.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero rating applies to (i) goods physically exported from Gibraltar to a destination outside Gibraltar within three months of the supply and (ii) services supplied to persons outside Gibraltar where the place of enjoyment is outside Gibraltar. The ELP must retain contemporaneous evidence of export, delivery outside Gibraltar, and consistent commercial payment terms.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Gibraltar Customs Export Declaration (SAD / Export Accompanying Document)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill (or certified international courier receipt)
Inward Remittance Certificate / SWIFT MT103 credit advice
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fraudulent export zero-rating claims expose the ELP to a retrospective six-year clawback of suppressed GCT, a penalty of up to 100% of the tax evaded, statutory interest, misdeclaration penalties of up to GBP 50,000, and criminal prosecution on conviction. Given the transparent pass-through classification, assessment and penalty liability may extend to the individual partners.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Bank of England (ultimate monetary authority for GBP clearing and settlement) together with the Gibraltar Financial Services Commission (GFSC) as the locally competent financial services regulator; the Government of Gibraltar issues the Gibraltar Pound (GIP) at a fixed statutory 1:1 parity to GBP. Gibraltar operates no independent central bank or foreign exchange administration.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Gibraltar maintains full, unrestricted convertibility on both capital and current account. There are no exchange control laws, no licensing requirements for cross-border transfers, and no restrictions on dividend or profit repatriation. GIP circulates at parity with GBP and is freely interchangeable, while the ELP may hold operational liquidity wholly in USD, EUR, or GBP without prior central bank approval. The only practical hurdles are documentary: banks require a clear capital-contribution narrative, beneficial ownership disclosure, and standard AML-compliant wire references; profit distributions to non-resident limited partners are processed as ordinary SWIFT transactions free of Gibraltar withholding tax under the ELP pass-through regime.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. Neither Gibraltar nor UK law imposes any statutory timeline, mandatory conversion ratio, or surrender obligation for export receipts. A Gibraltar ELP exporting food-grade silicone tactile fidgets may retain 100% of export proceeds in foreign currency accounts indefinitely, and conversion of USD or EUR receipts to GIP/GBP is at the sole commercial discretion of the partnership with no reporting requirement to any monetary authority.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account and Operational Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium feasibility for operational liquidity, platform payouts, and Swift_TT settlement; Low feasibility for capital escrow. GFSC-licensed electronic money institutions under the Financial Services Act 2019 can legally support low-risk fidget-toy revenue collection and marketplace disbursements, but a fully licensed tier-1 bank is mandatory for segregated partner capital injections. Post-Brexit, UK and EU EMI passporting into Gibraltar has ceased; unlicensed offshore digital EMIs cannot lawfully accept deposits from Gibraltar-regulated entities.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: A physical onboarding interview of the General Partner's director or an authorized signatory is normally mandated by tier-1 Gibraltar banks for a first-time ELP relationship. Remote opening is conditionally admissible only where a GFSC-licensed regulated introducer (law firm, accountancy firm, or corporate services provider) certifies the identity files; standalone video-KYC is insufficient for capital escrow accounts.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial ownership opacity of the pass-through ELP structure with non-resident limited partners
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified copy of the Gibraltar Limited Partnership registration certificate; notarized partnership deed and limited partnership agreement; register of limited partners; beneficial ownership filing acknowledgement from the Gibraltar registry; corporate general partner certificate of incumbency and director passport copies; full ownership structure chart traced to ultimate individuals.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source of funds ambiguity for the initial capital escrow injection
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Twelve months of bank statements for each contributing partner; source-of-wealth letter; tax clearance or tax residence certificates; audited financial statements of the general partner; executed sale, loan, or dividend agreements evidencing legitimate origin; independent professional reference from an existing regulated banker or lawyer.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Commercial rationale mismatch – low unit value fidget products with high transaction frequency
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed supply contracts and pro-forma invoices from silicone compression molders; customer and distributor agreements; 12-month revenue forecast and inventory plan; ISIC 3240 business scope statement; LFGB/FDA food-grade certification for silicone; e-commerce marketplace settlement and platform pay reports.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions, PEP, and tax-residency red flags for non-resident partners or counterparties
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Negative-media and sanctions screening results; PEP declaration forms; UK, EU, or Gibraltar tax residence certificates; evidence of economic substance in Gibraltar including registered office, local general partner director, and board minutes; entity-level AML risk questionnaire endorsed by a GFSC-regulated introducer.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant SWIFT MT103 transfers from each contributing partner's own bank account to the ELP's segregated capital escrow account at a Gibraltar tier-1 bank, with payment reference 'ELP capital contribution – no goods or services'. The remitting bank applies the standard capital-account purpose code (mapped internally as 'Equity Injection / Capital Contribution' under GFSC regulatory reporting; USD remittances clear via correspondent banking and are converted to SWIFT MT103). Verification requires the partner's source-of-funds documentation, the notarized partnership deed, and the general partner board resolution authorizing the injection. No Gibraltar central bank approval is required; only standard AML verification applies.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary rail: SWIFT MT103 priority telegraphic transfer for supplier settlements, including USD or cross-border RMB payments to Chinese compression-molding factories and GBP/EUR payments to European raw-material vendors. Secondary rail: Commercial Letter of Credit on a sight basis, confirmed where the supplier requires bank endorsement, settled through the Gibraltar bank's correspondent network for large production runs. Platform-pay refunds, dropship fees, and marketplace disbursements clear through GFSC-licensed EMI accounts via Swift_TT and Platform_Pay APIs. Domestic GBP disbursements settle via CHAPS; spot or forward FX conversion is executed by the ELP's tier-1 bank at the point of disbursement.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: FX swaps (spot-forward structures and swap-point rollovers)
Cross-currency swaps (USD/GBP and CNY/GBP with an existing underlying trade commitment)
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on CNY/USD and other restricted currencies executed with a GFSC-authorized counterparty
No GIP-specific NDF is required given the statutory GIP/GBP parity peg

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary of ELP registration; due within 28 days
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing fine of £5 per day up to £100; strike-off notice after 2 months default

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Beneficial Ownership, Government of Gibraltar
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: By 31 January following each calendar year end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Criminal penalty up to £5,000; removal from register of licenses upon persistent non-filing

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 30 June following the fiscal year end (31 March)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Penalty of £500; daily fine of £10 for continued failure; risk of mandatory re-inclusion in tax register
Late payment surcharge of 10% per month; registration suspended on 30 days notice

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory audit if turnover exceeds £17.6 million or total assets exceed £8.6 million; otherwise small-entity audit exemption applies unless a limited partner triggers a stipulation in the partnership agreement.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) as adopted for Gibraltar; alternatively Gibraltar Financial Reporting Standard (GFRS) for qualifying smaller entities.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: ELP must maintain a Register of Beneficial Owners at its registered office in Gibraltar and file an annual confirmation (UBO-CONF) on or before 31 January. Any transfer of a partnership interest must be reported to the Registrar within 14 days; the confirmation certifies that the register is up-to-date and accurate as of the previous year end.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members, Register of Directors, Minute Book

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 12.5% standard Gibraltar corporation tax rate; the ELP is tax-transparent, so entity-level rate is 0% and partners are taxed on allocated profits
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No statutory tax holiday for ISIC 3240 manufacturing. Territorial system taxes only income accruing in or derived from Gibraltar, effectively exempting foreign e-commerce trading profit. No VAT/GST, no capital gains tax (except Gibraltar land/buildings), no dividend WHT. Trading losses carry forward indefinitely (no statutory cap; sentinel -1 used in the data model).
